description: Extend the context compiler to consume the normalized graph, rank task-relevant files, preserve explicit and policy-required files, enforce context budgets, and emit auditable file-level context metadata.
acceptance_criteria: The compiler uses explicit files, policy-required files, task terms, memory, graph neighbors, and related tests as bounded ranking inputs.
Every selected file records path, bytes, estimated tokens, sha256, score, and inclusion reasons.
The compiler never exceeds configured file, byte, or token limits except for explicitly required files according to current policy semantics.
The output remains backward-compatible with current context.json consumers and identifies the graph backend used.
Tests cover ranking determinism, budget boundaries, explicit-file precedence, graph neighbors, memory, tests, and secret/generated-path exclusions.

planning.title: Extend context compiler with graph-aware file retrieval
